title: Event
description: Envelope of every webhook the gateway sends (FR-TXN-06). The per-type schemas in contracts/events/ narrow type and data.

id.description: Unique per event, the same on every delivery attempt. The merchant deduplicates on it.

livemode.description: true for a live-mode key (sp_live_...), false for test mode (sp_test_...). The two modes never mix (v2).

created_at.description: When the status change was committed. Not the signature timestamp, which is fresh on every attempt.

payment_id.description: The payment this event belongs to, also for refund events.

sequence.description: Per-payment order shared by payment and refund events. Ignore an event whose sequence is not higher than the one you stored.

object.description: Snapshot of the payment or refund at the moment of the change.
